title: The Green Lady's Trial
summary: In the deep canopy around Silvenar, strict Green Pact wardens and Wood Orc wood-shapers investigate timber-violating axes planted along the river trails to sabotage the Green Lady's trials.

hook.rumour: Freshly felled ironwood stumps were discovered near the trail to Silvenar with Orcish axe-heads wedged into the bark, though the Wood Orc clans swear the steel was forged outside the forest.
hook.notice: COURT OF THE SILVENAR: Pact-wardens and impartial trackers sought to examine the felled ironwood site and preserve the truce before the Green Lady's Trial.

npcs.name: Warden of Silvenar
npcs.greet: Freshly felled ironwood stumps were discovered near the trail to Silvenar with Orcish axe-heads wedged into the bark, though the Wood Orc clans swear the steel was forged outside the forest.
talk: The trouble across Malabal Tor began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Silvenar.
If you mean to help the Court of the Silvenar, start by checking the trail between Silvenar and Silvenars Audience Hall.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Silvenar
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Silvenars Audience Hall is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Silvenars Audience Hall toward Roadside Green Bough before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Silvenar so The Silvenar & Green Lady can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Roadside Green Bough
npcs.greet: You made good time from Silvenars Audience Hall. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Black Vine Villa.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Black Vine Villa with a picked guard.
Once Black Vine Villa is cleared, return to Silvenar to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Silvenar
npcs.greet: The Silvenar & Green Lady awaits word on whether the crisis in Malabal Tor has been contained.
talk: The elders of Silvenar have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Malabal Tor owes you a debt for standing between Silvenar and ruin.
